profile.name: 是德科技 UXR 系列示波器
profile.description: 用于采集和分析高速电子信号波形的高带宽实时示波器，支持测量统计读取与通道自动缩放设置，常用于电子测试、信号完整性分析和高速电路表征。
profile.description_en: A high-bandwidth real-time oscilloscope for acquiring and analyzing high-speed electronic waveforms. It supports reading measurement statistics and configuring channel autoscale, and is commonly used for electronic testing, signal integrity analysis, and high-speed circuit characterization.
